notes.title: Gemini’s Log #3 - Second Patch with Mac & Linux
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/2zoCidcQ9iQXS3GosG/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]Gemini’s Log, The Europa, Day 35[/h1]

Minor fixes to improve Algo Bot’s programmer experience.  
[list]
[*]Added MacOS & Linux support
[*]Added skip cinematic button
[*]Added options menu during gameplay.
[*]Improved level select menu
[*]Various interface & bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Gemini’s Log #2 - First Patch
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/1etnS31Fpj6NpSl31F/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]Gemini’s Log, The Europa, Day 15.[/h1]

Algo Bots have been updated to improve programming routines.
[list]
[*]Added keyboard controls & rebindable keys
[*]Added Japanese translation
[*]Fixed perfect score achievement triggering too early
[*]Fixed audio sliders
[*]Improved UI
[/list]

notes.title: Captain’s Log #7 - Command Center
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/xUOwG5tOD05kkfFbpu/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]Captain's Log, Earth, Day before departure.[/h1]

Last check on the Command Center before joining the Stasis Bay. After that Gemini will be in command until I wake up. 

Steam now allows developers to stream their game via the store pages. Ground control plans to try that new feature for the Launch tomorrow 14th of February 2018 on [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/286300/Algo_Bot/]Algo Bot’s Steam page[/url].

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31583650/4de90b9bd0b70c5d23e8cebd6b813d5247229c51.jpg[/img]

Thank you for following this Captain’s Log. See you on the far side of the galaxy.
